defs.def: great respect and admiration for sb 尊敬；尊重；崇敬

ex.s: in honor ofB. in search of

defs.def: something that you are very pleased or proud to do because people are showing you great respect 荣幸；光荣
the quality of knowing and doing what is morally right 正义感；道义；节操
a good reputation; respect from other people 荣誉；名誉；他人的尊敬

ex.s: After the People‘s Republic of China (PRC) was established, Yang was reburied with full military honours, in Tonghua, Jilin Province.
ex.t: 中华人民共和国成立后，杨靖宇在吉林省通化市以完整的军事荣誉礼仪重新安葬。

ex.s: He seemed to make it a point of honour to keep it at bay.
ex.t: 他似乎把遏制它当作一件关乎荣誉的事。

ex.s: Driven by a sense of commitment, a great many joined the army to resist the Japanese invaders and defend the honour of the nation.
ex.t: 在使命感的驱使下，许多人参军抵抗日本侵略者，捍卫国家荣誉。

ex.s: Later, Winton received various honours for his achievement, including a knighthood in 2003, and the Czech government's highest honour, the Order of the White Lion, in 2014.
ex.t: 后来，温顿因其成就获得诸多荣誉，包括 2003 年的骑士爵位，以及 2014 年捷克政府的最高荣誉“白狮勋章”。

defs.def: a person or thing that causes others to respect and admire sth/sb 引起尊敬（或尊重、崇敬）的人（或事物）

ex.s: To honor an outstanding AI expert.

defs.def: an award, official title, etc. given to sb as a reward for sth that they have done （为表扬某人的）奖励，荣誉称号，头衔
a university course that is of a higher level than a basic course (in the US also used to describe a class in school which is at a higher level than other classes) 常用作形容词
if you pass an exam or graduate from a university or school with honours, you receive a special mark/grade for having achieved a very high standard 优异成绩

ex.s: Through it all, she remained in good academic standing and graduated with honors.
ex.t: 在整个过程中她保持了良好的学术成绩并以优异成绩毕业。

defs.def: 法官大人；（美国）市长阁下
the cards that have the highest value 最大点数的牌
用人格担保；以名誉担保
to be trusted to do sth 受到信任；被信赖
to do sth that shows great respect for sb/sth 尊敬，尊重（某人）
to give public praise, an award or a title to sb for sth they have done 给予表扬（或奖励、头衔、称号）

ex.s: In this spirit, the Laureus World Sports Awards is an annual ceremony to honour remarkable sportspeople.
ex.t: 本着这种精神，劳伦斯世界体育奖是一年一度的颁奖典礼，旨在表彰杰出的运动员。

defs.def: to do what you have agreed or promised to do 信守，执行（承诺）
